axes.A_electroweak_weight: same normal form, different partition; a second class-A axis
axes.A_readout_weight: Record readout surface; one parameter per declared two-cell partition; discharged by a counting convention
axes.B_activation_scale: occurrence/probability surface; needs a formation or rate law, not a readout convention
axes.C_generator_normalization: gauge algebra surface; discharged by a unit convention

conclusion: The repo's normalization residuals are not one reference choice. They are at least four parameters in three classes on three different supplied surfaces, with pairwise-disjoint defining relations and a product solution set. A counting convention that fixes the readout weight discharges neither the activation scale nor the generator normalization, so the flagship lanes do not unblock together.
